column1: # The installer's one table of external programs.
# Everything here is installed for the current user — no sudo, no administrator,
# no system package manager.  The `installer` column says which user-level route
#   uv          the official uv installer (it also provides uvx)
#   uv-python   uv-managed Python 3.13 (macOS uses Homebrew's python@3.13)
#   provided    another installed tool supplies this executable
#   mqtt        a broker already listening is enough; otherwise mosquitto is
#   download    an official release binary in ~/.local/bin
#   node        the official Node.js LTS archive in ~/.local/lib/nodejs
#   system      must already be present (an OpenSSH client)
# Besides the programs, the installer always ensures uv and Python 3.13, and
# installs slife2 itself as a uv tool (standalone) or into the project venv
# (checkout).  `install_helper.py require` supplies the names the effective
# configuration actually uses; a name with no row here and no executable on
# PATH is a hard failure, never a silent skip.
